items.title: The scheme theoretic image of a proper morphism into a separated finite type space is proper

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in a commutative triangle X -> Y -> B over S with X -> B proper and Y -> B separated and locally of finite type, the scheme theoretic image Z of X -> Y is proper over B and X -> Z is surjective (source lines 8231-8248). The proof observes that h : X -> Y is quasi-compact by the permanence lemma, so |h|(|X|) is dense in |Z|; on the other hand that image is closed in |Y| by the permanence statement for universally closed morphisms, so X -> Z is surjective; properness of Z -> B then follows from the image-proper lemma.
